newsitem.title: USA: Apple to rehire co-founder Jobs - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Apple to rehire co-founder Jobs - newspaper.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc. is expected to rehire co-founder Steven Jobs to help the computer company update its operating system software, according to a report published Friday.
The Los Angeles Times, citing unidentified sources, said Jobs will be hired as a part-time consultant and "technology guru" in charge of the software project.
Jobs, who founded Apple with Stephen Wozniak, was ousted in 1985 after a power struggle with then chief-executive John Sculley.
The newspaper said Jobs would supervise the launch of the new Macintosh operating system, an eagerly awaited software update that is regarded as a critical step in Apple's future.
A spokesman for Apple was not immediately available to comment.
Apple's stock fell 50 cents to $21.75 in early trading on Nasdaq.
